units: B. Kam. 80ᵃ (expl. חולדת הסנאים) שרצא הוצא וא״ד ח׳ דקטיני וכ׳ Ms. M. (ed. שרצא חרצא; for oth. var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20; marginal vers. שרצא חרצא וא״ד חרצא) a creeping animal (which is) prickly, and some use the word ḥarza (spiny), with tiny legs. But why ‘creeping’?—Because its legs are low. V. חַרְצָא.—Fem. חַרְזִיתָא, pl. חַרְזְיָיתָא.

<cite ref="Eruvin 26b">Erub. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>אצוותא ח׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="H01623"><he>חֲרוּזְיָאחָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="H01623"><he>חֲרוּזְיָת׳</he></cite>), v. <cite ref="A02859"><he>אַצְוָוא</he></cite>.
